rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.

Line 95: "`[resolved:2026-08-23]` **Surface corrected.** The 2026-07-30 flag and its 2026-08-01 resolution were about claude.ai cross-chat search and incognito; the demo runs in Claude Code (Antti, 2026-08-23)." narrates a completed transition ("were about X ... now Y") rather than a standing fact -- the banned shape per §3's tense test ("was changed to Y", "used to be"). Per backing-format.md's own spec ("Cleared on resolution -- resolved items leave no residue ... An empty Flagged list is deleted, not kept as a stub"), a resolved Flagged item should be redistributed to Stance/OODA/Sources and removed, not left as a `[resolved:...]` residue entry -- this entry violates the format its own compendium defines. content-rules.md explicitly bars "this is bookkeeping, not prose" as an excuse for maintainer/<!-- backing --> content, so scope is not in question. Same shape recurs at line 76 inside the demo-fires-live source stamp: "The earlier stamp here tracked claude.ai cross-chat search and incognito; that surface was never the demo's (Antti, 2026-08-23) and its findings do not transfer." Everything actionable in both clauses is already stated as present-tense fact in the Demo watch-fors standing instruction (line 55, three-fresh-sessions-in-an-empty-directory) and in the same source line's forward instruction ("Owed before each cohort: three fresh sessions in an empty directory ... then `result:ATTESTED`"), so cutting both clauses loses nothing actionable -- the fix does not degrade the artefact, it removes duplicated journey narration and brings the Flagged entry into the format its own spec (backing-format.md) requires.
